parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The two methods — `defaultsToV1WhenNoOverrideOrFlag` and `returnsV1WhenFeatureFlagIsV1` — are distinct test cases that verify different behavioural conditions (absence of any override vs. an explicit feature-flag value of V1); their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) reflects shared test scaffolding, not accidental duplication. Collapsing them would obscure the separate failure modes each test is designed to catch, reducing diagnostic clarity.
